$comment: Editor hints only: no type, enum or required, because Helm reports a schema failure under the bare subchart name. Values are validated in templates/_validations.tpl.
title: Values Schema for MapColonies Labels and Annotations

environment.description: The environment in which the deployment is running

partOf.description: The system this deployment is part of (required)

owner.description: The team that owns this deployment (required)

gisDomain.description: The GIS domain this deployment relates to

enabled.description: Whether Prometheus metrics are enabled for this deployment (required when prometheus is set)

port.description: The port on which Prometheus metrics are exposed

path.description: The path on which Prometheus metrics are exposed, starting with /

logScraping.description: Whether to enable log scraping for this deployment
